translations.szidConcertFb111Live01: The local Café Lizette street gang jumps the band in the parking lot and beat the living daylights out of them as a showing of dislike for their music. Mind your back.
translations.szidConcertFb121Live01: Two songs in and the crowd started booing.\n   Halfway through the third song they start pelting the band. Besieged by flying objects it becomes difficult to see the band and Lizette escorts them offstage herself.\n   <getrandommusician().name>'s stage costume is ruined by a banana split that somebody launched.
translations.szidConcertFb131Live01: Tonight's venue is full and condensation drips from the ceiling as the crowd gear up for the show. Soon after the intro the jeering makes the music inaudible. The band has no option but to cut and run.\n   The band are not too cheerful but Lizette is, she cleaned up on bar sales after the band made a run for it.
translations.szidConcertFb211Live01: Despite a sparsely filled venue consisting of a few locals and hangers-on, the band seem to have a good time.\n   Lizette loses money and says she won't come near you again before you get some fans.
translations.szidConcertFb221Live01: It is a decent concert and at least the crowd like it enough to see it through.\n   Post-gig the band sulk and they don't want to talk about it.
translations.szidConcertFb231Live01: Café Lizette is ram-packed, the air is stifling. The gig is a roaring success, even Lizette looks happy pouring more beer.\n   Your band think it's encouraging to play to a capacity crowd but feel they could still do better.
translations.szidConcertFb311Live01: The band do an OK gig despite the small audience. Post-gig some teenagers approach to thank the band for a good concert.
translations.szidConcertFb321Live01: Café Lizette is only half full, but the gig is excellent and the teenagers dance like maniacs which makes the band try even harder to excite them.
translations.szidConcertFb331Live01: Many people show up and they all seem to enjoy the show. The teenagers dance with each other on the tables.
translations.szidConcertFb411Live01: Almost no one shows up but the band plays on and performs a marvelous set.\n   Lizette is none too pleased. Backstage she rollicks at the band who pay no attention and continue to indulge in free beer and post gig activities.
translations.szidConcertFb421Live01: Put simply: the band is on top form. After the concert, both the audience and the band are exhausted, but everybody is happy.\n   Lizette mutters something about more people but is satisfied nevertheless.
translations.szidConcertFb431Live01: Most of Rock City's bored teenagers show up to get some entertainment for a change.\n   They get more than they bargained for, because <¤Cband.name> deliver a gig that will change their lives forever. Café Lizette's best ever gig.
translations.szidConcertFb111Live02: The only crowd to show up at Rock Pit are two rival street gangs who seem to have come for a show down.\n   Halfway through the gig, they stop beating each other, instead setting upon the band. The gig is a disaster and you flee the scene of the crime to escape the bloodthirsty gang bangers.
translations.szidConcertFb121Live02: Two songs in and the crowd started booing. Halfway through the third song they start pelting the band.\n   Mesh chicken wire separates the stage from the Rock Pit audience and ultimately saves the band from them. But when the crowd starts tearing the protective wiring down, the bouncers wade in to escort the band offstage.\n   Later the cleaners find a spent bullet on the stage.
translations.szidConcertFb131Live02: Tonight's venue is full and condensation drips from the ceiling as the crowd gear up for the show. Soon after the intro the jeering makes the music inaudible. The band has no option but to cut and run.\n   The band are not too cheerful but the promoter is, he cleaned up on bar sales after the band made a run for it.
translations.szidConcertFb211Live02: Despite a sparsely filled venue consisting of a few locals and hangers-on, the band seems to have a good time.\n   The promoter loses money and says he won't come near you again until you get some fans.
translations.szidConcertFb221Live02: Rock Pit is half full. The gig will soon be forgotten, but <¤Cband.name> offer some entertainment for the moment and everybody seem content.
translations.szidConcertFb231Live02: <¤Cplace.Name> is ram-packed, the air is stifling. The gig is a roaring success, even the proprietor looks happy pouring more beer.\n   Your band think it's encouraging to play to a capacity crowd but feel they could still do better.
translations.szidConcertFb311Live02: Rock Pit is almost empty and it's so cold that your fingers become stiff. It's hard to play, but <¤cband.name> show good spirit and manage to do a real good gig fuelled with energy and will power.
translations.szidConcertFb321Live02: Successful show. A decent number of people show up and all seem to like the concert. Even the band seems happy.
translations.szidConcertFb331Live02: Rock Pit is filled to brim and the show is outstanding. As an extra effect, somebody discharges tear gas onto the dance floor toward the end of the gig, which evacuates the venue. Strangely, that only seems to add to the flavour.
translations.szidConcertFb411Live02: Almost no one shows up but the band plays on and performs a marvelous set. The owner of <¤Cplace.Name> is none to pleased.\n   Backstage he rollicks at the band who pay no attention and continue to indulge in free beer and post gig activities.
translations.szidConcertFb421Live02: Put simply: the band is on top form. After the concert both the audience and the band are exhausted, but everybody is happy.\n   The owner mutters something about more people but is satisfied nevertheless.
translations.szidConcertFb431Live02: During the encore the crowd rushes the stage and in the pandemonium some of the band's gear is destroyed.\n   The band loves it, though.
translations.szidConcertFb111Live03: The show is a disaster and Mirror Ball is almost empty. The few guests repeatedly ask the band to stop and finally the promoter interrupts the show because his guests complained.
translations.szidConcertFb121Live03: Mirror Ball is only half full and the gig is a disaster. The crowd boos so much they spill their Dry Martinis.
translations.szidConcertFb131Live03: The crowd throw coins and surprisingly even folded wallets at the band but when <¤CRealMusician.name> receives a cut above the eye from a heavy coin, the show is stopped.\n   You find $170 on stage.
translations.szidConcertFb211Live03: The only attendants are some dinner guests who at first seem disturbed by the unwanted concert, but soon find out they like the show and give the band warm applause when they go off stage.
translations.szidConcertFb221Live03: It is a big crowd tonight, but nobody seems to have come for the concert. They just hang out in the bar, drinking, talking and trying to get lucky. <¤Cband.name> is but a musical backdrop to the jet set lifestyle.
translations.szidConcertFb231Live03: Mirror Ball is jam packed, but the show never really takes off. Soon the audience loses interest and start talking to each other. Only a few devoted fans up front stay throughout.
translations.szidConcertFb311Live03: It is a promising show. Pity there is hardly anyone there to see it. Anyway, the little crowd joins you backstage for a post-gig party in the dressing room.
translations.szidConcertFb321Live03: It's a good show and a decent-size crowd. They all seem to have come for the show and nobody is disappointed.
translations.szidConcertFb331Live03: Good gig and a huge crowd. The expensive suits reflect in the huge mirror ball hanging from the ceiling.
translations.szidConcertFb411Live03: Almost no one shows up but the band plays on and performs a marvelous set. The owner of <¤Cplace.Name> is none to pleased.\n   Backstage he rollicks at the band who pay no attention and continue to indulge in free beer and post gig activities.
translations.szidConcertFb421Live03: Put simply: the band is on top form. After the concert both the audience and the band are exhausted, but everybody is happy.\n   The owner mutters something about more people but is satisfied nevertheless.
translations.szidConcertFb431Live03: An unforgettable evening: <¤Cplace.Name> is packed to the rafters and with expectations high the band take to the stage and let no one down.\n They deliver a vibrating, gyrating, sweaty raw power knock out show.\n During the encore, <¤CRealMusicianVocals.Name> joins the crowd to dance and party with them. Pure magic.
translations.szidConcertFb111Live04: The gig is embarrassingly poor and the only attendants are some tattooed old rockers who warn you about ever playing here again, their point being that Avenue is no place for third class acts.
translations.szidConcertFb121Live04: You can only play a few songs before the music lovers who hang out at Avenue cut the power in protest.
translations.szidConcertFb131Live04: Avenue is full of people and expectations are high. Pity <¤Cband.name> give such a lousy show. When the singer misses the cue for the fifth time in a row, most of the audience leave, and the remainder do their best to ignore the band.
translations.szidConcertFb211Live04: The show is OK and the enthusiastic music-lovers who make up the little audience seem to have found a new promising band to love.
translations.szidConcertFb221Live04: The gig is honestly speaking not very good. The venue is half full and opinions divided among the audience, but most agree that <¤Cband.name> are very far from Rock 'n' Roll heaven.
translations.szidConcertFb231Live04: <¤Cplace.Name> is ram-packed, the air is stifling. The gig is a roaring success, even the proprietor looks happy pouring more beer.\n   The band is angry they couldn't do better when so much people came to see them play.
translations.szidConcertFb311Live04: It is a classic show and in time, a lot more people will claim they were here to see it, than you can actually count in the scarce crowd tonight.
translations.szidConcertFb321Live04: The band goes down well with the crowd who seem to enjoy the show. Post-gig the band say the show went OK.
translations.szidConcertFb331Live04: It is a great show and rock lovers of all ages take <¤Cband.name> to their hearts.
translations.szidConcertFb411Live04: It's a fabulous show and a shame that so few show up to enjoy it. The promoter has tears in his eyes when he explains that it's a pleasure losing money on such a fantastic band.
translations.szidConcertFb421Live04: The concert is outstanding and the crowd refuse to leave despite <¤Cband.name> doing five encores. When you start to take down the equipment they are still clapping and shouting, hoping for more.
translations.szidConcertFb431Live04: An unforgettable evening. <¤Cband.name> do the gig of a lifetime and during the encore the promoter comes on stage to kiss <¤crealmusicianvocals.name>.
translations.szidConcertFb111Live05: The gig is delayed because the band gets lost in the hallways below the stage. It doesn't really matter though, because hardly anyone shows up anyhow. Total failure.
translations.szidConcertFb121Live05: The crowd seems honestly upset by the crap show and eventually the promoter cuts the power, not being able to stand the horrible sounds being produced in his venue.
translations.szidConcertFb131Live05: Palladium is full to the last seat, but the show is bad and the crowd leaves after a few songs and some booing.
translations.szidConcertFb211Live05: Despite a sparsely filled venue consisting of a few locals and hangers-on the band seem to have a good time.\n   The promoter says he's not into charity and that you better shape up if you ever wanna play here again.
translations.szidConcertFb221Live05: The show is OK and at least the crowd stays throughout. No demand for encores, though.
translations.szidConcertFb231Live05: The show is good and it's a big crowd. The band is unhappy that they could not do better, when they had the chance.
translations.szidConcertFb311Live05: The few enthusiasts who show up are rewarded with a great concert. The place is only ten per cent full, but if you close your eyes, you can imagine that this is a classic concert.
translations.szidConcertFb321Live05: The gig is successful, the band are happy, the promoter is happy, and you make some money. Who could ask for more?
translations.szidConcertFb331Live05: The place is packed and the show is great. Only the eyes of the fans waiting to get autographs outshine the band's smiles.
translations.szidConcertFb411Live05: <¤Cband.name> give an excellent show, unfortunately echoing emptily in the huge Palladium ballroom.
translations.szidConcertFb421Live05: Put simply: the band is on top form. After the concert, both the audience and the band are exhausted, but everybody is happy.\n   The owner mutters something about more people but is satisfied nevertheless.
translations.szidConcertFb431Live05: The Palladium ballroom is packed full and the show is outstanding. During the encore, everybody throw their arms in the air and it's an inspiring sight for the band.
translations.szidConcertFb111Live06: The only audience is the promoter and a stray dog that found its way into the arena. Nobody can blame the band for having difficulties performing in such a setting.
translations.szidConcertFb121Live06: The Colosseum is half full, but the crowd seems to regret paying the cover charge. Two songs in the music drown in the noise from the crowd-barrier being kicked down and you decide to cut and run.
translations.szidConcertFb131Live06: It's a big crowd but the rain is pouring down and they seem too busy staying dry to watch the show. The band does a lousy gig and everyone thinks this concert is best forgotten.
translations.szidConcertFb211Live06: Despite a sparsely filled arena consisting of a few friends and family, the band seem to have a good time.\n   The promoter loses money and says he won't come near you again until you get some fans.
translations.szidConcertFb221Live06: The concert is not so bad and the crowd is actually big. Too bad the huge stadium makes it look depressingly empty in front of the stage.
translations.szidConcertFb231Live06: <¤Cband.name> fill the Colosseum, but they do not deliver much of a show. Toward the end of the show, only half the audience remains.
translations.szidConcertFb311Live06: The Colosseum is empty, but the echo in the deserted arena works, as a huge special effect inspiring the band and the concert becomes an extraordinary musical experiment.
translations.szidConcertFb321Live06: It is an excellent show. During the encore, <¤Crealmusicianvocals.name> brings a girl from the audience on stage to dance with her to the audience's delight.
translations.szidConcertFb331Live06: All lighters are up when <¤cband.name> do a ballad. It is an amazing sight and the end of a good concert.
translations.szidConcertFb411Live06: The Colosseum is nearly empty. The band still go out and give all they have for the few fans that paid for their tickets. They really get their money's worth, because it is a very special show.
translations.szidConcertFb421Live06: <¤Cband.name> do an outstanding show and the audience are all for it. They climb on top of each other, jump, shout, sing along, stage dive and surf the crowd.
translations.szidConcertFb431Live06: The volume of the teenagers screaming on the top of their lungs is unbearable. You hide offstage as <¤Cband.name> do the gig of a lifetime in a sold out Colosseum.
